system.summary: Ten fairies dancing in a circle restore the energy of a meal or the benefits of eight hours of sleep.
system.description: If a creature suffers from dehydration, hunger, or physical or psychic exhaustion, a group of ten fairies can dance in a ring around the one in need and provide both strength and power. A creature that is hungry or thirsty gains new energy, which represents one meal of food. A creature that is exhausted is refreshed as if having slept for one full night, and gains the normal effects of eight hours of sleep.
